scope: kernel-only Wi-Fi SYS_ERROR attribution, DWC3 Host PHY/LPM restoration and Bluetooth discovery diagnostics

findings.wifi: The first conf_tx sends all four WMM ACs after add_interface zeroed arvif. Three AC tuples were zero. All four standard EDCA defaults are now initialized before vdev creation; the upstream HW21 start sequence remains intact. Fatal callbacks dump MHI/BHI registers and a committed 16-entry WMI/HTT history before teardown.
findings.usb: Stock b5q has dis_u2_susphy but not dis_enblslpm. Linux restores USB2 SUSPHY=0 and ENBLSLPM=1, then enables USB3 SUSPHY after PHY initialization. The prior code cleared all three bits. First U3/HCE now dumps 16 bounded event TRBs. Apple USB2 LPM policy is an integer platform/boot-arg policy with default zero, not a Linux boolean, so no speculative property was added.
findings.bluetooth: The IBS wake path restores the clock before injecting the single GPIO-consumed WAKE_IND, and H4 state advances only over UART-accepted bytes. Type0 selects standard extended scan commands but does not synthesize Classic Inquiry. Health output now exposes all five discovery triplets and framing/drop/backpressure/error counters.
